name: DAComp
intro: DAComp包含210个任务，模拟复杂企业数据智能工作流，涵盖工业级架构的数据工程和开放式业务问题的数据分析。该基准用于评估自主数据智能体在企业环境中的能力。
org: Institute of Automation, CAS; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; ByteDance Seed; TikTok; UC San Diego; NUS
build_method: 八位专家构建, 宽松许可企业资产, 合成关系数据
metric: 组件分数, 级联失败分数, 严格成功率, 层次化评分, GSB
modality: 文本, 代码, 表格, SQL
task_type: Agent任务, 代码生成, SQL Generation, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 全生命周期, 仓库级数据工程, 开放式数据分析, 执行与大模型混合评测
task_type_en: Agent Task, Code Generation, SQL Generation, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Eight-expert Curation, Permissively Licensed Enterprise Assets, Relational Synthetic Data
intro_en: DAComp includes 210 tasks simulating complex enterprise data intelligence workflows, covering industrial-scale data engineering architectures and open-ended business data analysis. This benchmark is used to evaluate the capabilities of autonomous data agents in enterprise environments.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.04324, especially Sections 2.1-2.3, Figure 2, and Tables 1-2. Eight experts ground DAComp in 73 permissively licensed enterprise SaaS schemas plus relationally consistent synthetic data and 100 curated analytical databases. The diagram preserves the four task counts: 30 DE-architecture, 30 DE-implementation, 50 DE-evolution, and 100 DA tasks. It also preserves the paper's task-design details, including eight DA questions drafted per analysis-ready table and five-expert voting to retain two. Deterministic DE implementation/evolution outputs use component score, cascading-failure score, and strict success rate; DE architecture uses a rubric; DA uses hierarchical valid solution paths plus Good-Same-Bad scoring, with at least three annotators and a five-model coverage validation.
